description: This file is a helper class used in testing the persistence layer of the Things service, specifically for interacting with an in-memory Akka persistence journal to retrieve and process event data related to 'things'.

classes.name: ThingsJournalTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class for testing Akka persistence journal entries related to 'things'. It provides methods to fetch all events associated with a specific ThingId by querying in-memory persistence journal.

methods.name: ThingsJournalTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with the actor system, functions to map ThingId to persistence ID and journal entries to domain objects, and setting up the in-memory read journal.

methods.name: getAllEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all events related to the given ThingId by querying the in-memory journal and converting the event envelopes into domain objects.

methods.name: getAllEventEnvelopes
methods.description: Fetches all event envelopes for a specified persistence ID from the in-memory journal.

methods.name: convertEventEnvelopeToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts an EventEnvelope into a domain object of type J using the journalEntryToDomainObject function.

methods.name: runBlockingWithReturn
methods.description: Runs an Akka Source stream synchronously, collecting the elements into a list, handling exceptions as needed.
